items.text: THE RECORDS PROVIDE INSIGHTS INTO MUCH THAT WAS PUZZLING.

items.text: THIS MATERIAL IS OF SMALL VALUE.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: YOUR SUCCESS AT PODAL PLAZA IS NOTED.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: THE COUNCIL HAS VOTED A SPECIAL PRIZE FOR ENDING THE GRAVEYARD MENACE.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: THE COUNCIL WAS PLEASED BY THE ELIMINATION OF THE THIEVES IN KOVEL MANSION.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: WITH THE CLEARING OF THE STOJONOW RIVER, WE CAN OPEN UP THE HINTERLANDS FOR TRADE.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: WE WERE PLEASANTLY SURPRISED THAT YOU COMPLETED YOUR MISSION SO SWIFTLY. CADORNA WAS WAGERING YOUR RETURN WOULD BE MUCH DELAYED.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: YOUR ELIMINATION OF THE LIZARDMEN MENACE HAS GREATLY IMPROVED OUR STRATEGIC POSITION.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: THIS LOSS OF THE KOBOLD FORCES WILL BE A MAJOR BLOW TO THE ENEMY.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: WE WERE MUCH RELIEVED BY THE NEWS YOU BRING FROM THE NOMAD CAMP.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: COUNCILMAN CADORNA LEFT THIS PAYMENT FOR SOME SERVICE YOU HAD RENDERED.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: YOUR TAKING THE GATE WILL ENABLE OUR FORCES TO ASSAULT THE ENEMY STRONGHOLD. RETURN THERE TO LEAD THE ATTACK.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: CONGRATULATIONS! YOUR QUEST IS OVER! TYRANTHRAXUS IS DEFEATED! PHLAN IS FREE! IF YOU WISH, YOU MAY CONTINUE TO HELP US CLEAR ANY REMAINING MONSTERS. ALL PHLAN SALUTES YOU!
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: YOUR CLEARING OF THE SLUM AREAS PERMITS US TO EXPAND.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: CONGRATULATIONS, YOU MAY KEEP ALL YOU FOUND IN THE TEMPLE OF BANE AS A REWARD.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: PORPHYRYS CADORNA IS A TRAITOR TO THE CITY. IF YOU FIND HIM, KILL HIM.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: THE COUNCIL HAS NOTED THE PASSING OF THE TRAITOR CADORNA.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: UNDEAD FROM THE GRAVEYARD HAVE GROWN MORE DANGEROUS THAN ALL OF THE OTHER FORCES WHICH CONFRONT US.
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: 'I HAVE BEEN AUTHORIZED TO GIVE YOU AN ENCHANTED WEAPON IF YOU ACCEPT THE COMMISSION TO END THE GRAVEYARD MENACE. DO YOU ACCEPT?'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: 'EXCELLENT.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: THE CLERK SHUFFLES THROUGH HER PAPERS. 'ON THE MATTER OF COMMISSION,' SHE SAYS, 'I CAN OFFER THE FOLLOWING: '
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: 'BACK SO SOON? I CAN ONLY REPEAT THE EARLIER OFFERS: '
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: THE SLUMS IMMEDIATELY TO OUR WEST NEED TO BE CLEARED OF MONSTERS.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: SOKAL KEEP ON THORN ISLAND MUST BE CLEARED.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: THE COUNCIL IS OFFERING A REWARD FOR BOOKS, MAPS, TOMES, ETC. WHICH PROVIDE USEFUL INFORMATION ABOUT PHLAN BEFORE THE FALL. THE REWARD IS TIED TO THE VALUE OF THE INFORMATION.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: A WEAPON OF GREAT POWER IS TO BE AUCTIONED TO OUR ENEMIES. THIS AUCTION IS TO BE HELD IN PODAL PLAZA. FIND OUT WHAT THE WEAPON IS AND RETURN.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: JUNIOR COUNCILMAN CADORNA HAS A SPECIAL COMMISSION FOR YOU. HIS CHAMBERS ARE THROUGH THE EAST DOOR.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: YOU ARE SUMMONED BY THE BISHOP OF BRACCIO OF TYR. REPORT TO HIM AT TYR'S TEMPLE.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: A LARGE GROUP OF THIEVES OPERATES OUT OF THE OLD KOVEL MANSION. THE COUNCIL WILL PAY TO HAVE THEM CLEANED OUT.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: FIND THE NOMADS AND STOP THEM FROM JOINING FORCES WITH OUR ENEMIES.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: A LARGE TRIBE OF KOBOLDS IS BEING RECRUITED BY THE ENEMY. MAKE SURE THEY DON'T JOIN THE ENEMY FORCES.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: FIND THE SOURCE OF THE RIVER'S POLLUTION AND END IT.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: A TRIBE OF LIZARDMEN IS PREPARING TO JOIN THE ENEMY. PREVENT THIS.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: THE HEIR TO THE HOUSE OF BIVANT MUST BE RESCUED. WE WILL PAY GENEROUSLY FOR HIS SAFE RETURN.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: LORD CADORNA HAS A DELICATE DIPLOMATIC MISSION THAT REQUIRES YOUR PARTICULAR SKILLS. YOU ARE SUMMONED TO HIS CHAMBERS. GO THROUGH THE SOUTH DOOR.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: WE NEED YOU TO DELIVER A MESSAGE TO THE ZHENTIL KEEP TO THE WEST. BE CAREFUL, THE TRAITOR CADORNA MAY HAVE TAMPERED WITH THE MESSAGE PACKET BEFORE HE FLED.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: LORD URSLINGEN WISHES URGENTLY TO SPEAK WITH YOU. GO THROUGH THE SOUTH DOOR OF THE TRAITOR CADORNA'S OLD QUARTERS.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: YOU ARE SUMMONED TO A SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING. YOU ARE TO BE AWARDED A VALUABLE COMMISSION. THE CITY GUARDS WILL SHOW YOU THE WAY.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: 'THESE ARE ALL OF THE COMMISSIONS CURRENTLY AVAILABLE.'
items.direction: Measured civic fantasy narration; perform quoted council speech with formal authority while preserving the narrator identity

items.text: YOU ARE INTERCEPTED BY THE COUNCIL GUARD. 'HALT. YOUR PRESENCE IS NOT AUTHORIZED. LEAVE.' DO YOU LEAVE?
